current evidence supports the current cell

DELL_W_DEMAND_BACKLOG.metric_or_event: AI-server orders, backlog, deployment or repeat demand
DELL_W_DEMAND_BACKLOG.threshold: one current quantified or named company disclosure
DELL_W_DEMAND_BACKLOG.next_evidence_route: Dell earnings release, 10-Q/10-K or investor presentation

DELL_W_DEMAND_REVERSAL.metric_or_event: AI-server cancellation, digestion or demand slowdown
DELL_W_DEMAND_REVERSAL.threshold: issuer identifies a material slowdown, cancellation or digestion event
DELL_W_DEMAND_REVERSAL.next_evidence_route: Dell earnings release, call transcript or filing risk update

DELL_W_AI_MARGIN.metric_or_event: AI-server gross or operating profit and mix-to-margin bridge
DELL_W_AI_MARGIN.threshold: issuer isolates AI-server profit or supplies a reproducible mix bridge
DELL_W_AI_MARGIN.next_evidence_route: Dell segment note, earnings tables or investor presentation

DELL_W_CASH_CONVERSION.metric_or_event: AI-server working capital and cash conversion
DELL_W_CASH_CONVERSION.threshold: issuer separates AI-server inventory, receivables or cash impact
DELL_W_CASH_CONVERSION.next_evidence_route: Dell cash-flow statement, working-capital commentary or segment disclosure

DELL_W_SUPPLY_RELIEF.metric_or_event: component availability, lead time and supplier diversification
DELL_W_SUPPLY_RELIEF.threshold: issuer reports shorter lead time, broader sourcing or fewer constraints
DELL_W_SUPPLY_RELIEF.next_evidence_route: Dell earnings commentary and supplier disclosures

DELL_W_MARGIN_PRESSURE.metric_or_event: AI-server pricing, component cost and ISG margin
DELL_W_MARGIN_PRESSURE.threshold: issuer links pricing or component cost to a material ISG margin decline
DELL_W_MARGIN_PRESSURE.next_evidence_route: Dell segment results and earnings commentary

MU_W_HBM_COMMITMENT.metric_or_event: HBM commitments, capacity allocation and shipment coverage
MU_W_HBM_COMMITMENT.threshold: issuer quantifies multi-period commitments, allocation or shipment coverage
MU_W_HBM_COMMITMENT.next_evidence_route: Micron earnings release, 10-Q/10-K or investor presentation

MU_W_HBM_WEAKENING.metric_or_event: HBM orders, qualification and deployment demand
MU_W_HBM_WEAKENING.threshold: issuer reports order reduction, reallocation or weaker qualification demand
MU_W_HBM_WEAKENING.next_evidence_route: Micron earnings commentary and customer qualification updates

MU_W_HBM_ECONOMICS.metric_or_event: HBM revenue, gross margin, operating profit or price-volume-mix
MU_W_HBM_ECONOMICS.threshold: issuer isolates HBM economics or provides a reproducible PVM bridge
MU_W_HBM_ECONOMICS.next_evidence_route: Micron segment/product disclosure and earnings tables

MU_W_HBM_CASH.metric_or_event: HBM capex, inventory, prepayment and cash conversion
MU_W_HBM_CASH.threshold: issuer isolates an HBM-specific capital or cash item
MU_W_HBM_CASH.next_evidence_route: Micron cash-flow, capex and inventory disclosures

MU_W_CAPACITY_DISCIPLINE.metric_or_event: HBM and conventional DRAM capacity allocation
MU_W_CAPACITY_DISCIPLINE.threshold: Micron and at least one named peer retain bounded capacity plans despite volatility
MU_W_CAPACITY_DISCIPLINE.next_evidence_route: Micron, Samsung and SK hynix official capacity commentary

MU_W_PRICING_BREAK.threshold: issuer reports a material price decline or HBM weakening tied to supply or competition
MU_W_PRICING_BREAK.next_evidence_route: Micron earnings tables and named-peer official disclosures

NVDA_W_REPEAT_DEPLOYMENT.metric_or_event: named-cloud deployment, capacity expansion or utilization
NVDA_W_REPEAT_DEPLOYMENT.threshold: NVIDIA or a named cloud partner reports another deployment or expansion event
NVDA_W_REPEAT_DEPLOYMENT.next_evidence_route: NVIDIA and named-cloud official releases or filings

NVDA_W_DEMAND_DIGESTION.metric_or_event: deployment delay, concentration loss or accelerator demand slowdown
NVDA_W_DEMAND_DIGESTION.threshold: issuer or named customer identifies a material digestion or delay event
NVDA_W_DEMAND_DIGESTION.next_evidence_route: NVIDIA and named-customer official releases or filings

NVDA_W_PRODUCT_ECONOMICS.metric_or_event: accelerator or Data Center product revenue and profit
NVDA_W_PRODUCT_ECONOMICS.threshold: issuer publishes comparable product revenue and profit authority
NVDA_W_PRODUCT_ECONOMICS.next_evidence_route: NVIDIA earnings tables, segment note or investor presentation

NVDA_W_MARGIN_MIX.metric_or_event: product mix, supply cost, service mix and margin
NVDA_W_MARGIN_MIX.threshold: issuer quantifies a bridge explaining gross or operating margin movement
NVDA_W_MARGIN_MIX.next_evidence_route: NVIDIA earnings release and margin commentary

NVDA_W_REALIZED_CONSTRAINT.metric_or_event: realized supply, export, deployment or concentration constraint
NVDA_W_REALIZED_CONSTRAINT.threshold: issuer or official named counterparty reports a realized constraint with material scope
NVDA_W_REALIZED_CONSTRAINT.next_evidence_route: NVIDIA, named-counterparty or effective-policy official source

NVDA_W_CONSTRAINT_ABSENCE.metric_or_event: deployment expansion without the hypothesized bottleneck
NVDA_W_CONSTRAINT_ABSENCE.threshold: two bounded official updates show expansion without the hypothesized constraint
NVDA_W_CONSTRAINT_ABSENCE.next_evidence_route: NVIDIA and named-cloud official releases or filings

authority_boundary.fixture_choices: engineering proof only, never business truth
